description: Dreadnaught Helmet Level 60 Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreadnaught Helmet if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Helmet, 15 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 5 Arcanite Bars and 1 Nexus Crystal. Requirements: - Desecrated Helmet - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 15 - Arcanite Bar x 5 - Nexus Crystal
name: Dreadnaught Helmet
